title: I know a tad bit about technology. The one thing I have never been able to master is how Bluetooth works between my phone and my car... Total crap sho
summary: I know a tad bit about technology. The one thing I have never been able to master is how Bluetooth works between my phone and my car... Total crap shoot. Either have to restart car, my phone, both or delete and re pair devices... No clear pattern yet as to what works when
author: Greg McVerry
